name: SME Centre Division Meeting Minutes
description: Weekly/Monthly division meeting minutes template for SME Centre@SMF. Use for recording attendance, KPI updates, project updates, marketing updates, and action items from division meetings. Captures Singapore English terms and local context.

sections.title: Meeting Header
sections.instruction: Record the meeting title, date, time, and venue at the top of the minutes.
sections.item_format: Minutes of Meeting for SME Centre Division Meeting held on [Day], [Date] at [Venue]

sections.title: Staff Present
sections.instruction: List all staff present with their initials, name, and designation. Format as numbered list with initials in brackets after name.

sections.title: Staff Absent with Apologies
sections.instruction: List any staff who sent apologies for absence.

sections.title: Matters Arising from Previous Minutes
sections.instruction: Record any matters arising from the previous meeting minutes. If none, state 'There were no matters arising from the minutes of the previous meeting.'

sections.title: KPI Updates
sections.instruction: Record all KPI achievement updates. Include baseline percentages, stretch target percentages, and commentary on progress. Break down by indicator: BAS, BCE, GBU, CF (Grant/Toolkits/Business Matching), CFNG, Business Matching, Training Hours, Success Stories, Customer Satisfaction Survey.
sections.item_format: [KPI Indicator]: [Achievement details with percentages and commentary]

sections.title: Project Updates
sections.instruction: Record updates on GBU projects, policy changes, toolkit development, and other ongoing initiatives. Include any new proposals, changes in scope, and action items assigned.
sections.item_format: [Project/Item]: [Update details with action items and responsible persons noted]

sections.title: Marketing Team Updates
sections.instruction: Record updates from the marketing team including SME Scan reports, corporate identity guidelines, event materials, collateral approvals, and any marketing-related decisions.

sections.title: Technology & Tools Updates
sections.instruction: Record any updates on internal tools, platforms, or technology pilots (e.g., Transcribe, CRM systems, recording tools) including feedback from BAs and adoption status.

sections.title: Governance & Compliance
sections.instruction: Record any governance, compliance, or policy matters including KPI verification issues, audit findings, code of conduct reminders, and vendor arm's-length requirements.

sections.title: Any Other Business (AOB)
sections.instruction: Record any other business items not covered above. Include strategic planning updates, upcoming events, new proposals, and general announcements.

sections.title: Action Items Summary
sections.instruction: Summarise all action items discussed, including who is responsible (Action By) and any deadlines. Use initials to identify responsible persons.

sections.title: Meeting Close
sections.instruction: Record the next meeting date and time, adjournment time, and the names of the minute-taker and approver.
sections.item_format: Next meeting: [Date] at [Time]. Meeting concluded at [Time]. Recorded by: [Name]. Approved by: [Name].
